chars.BOY: BOY: a small 9-year-old boy (short, child-sized) wearing a bright red hoodie, blue jeans and a small green school backpack.
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a white headscarf.
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan father with a thick black moustache, wearing a brown leather jacket over a grey shirt and dark trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room with traditional low sofas and zellige tiles, MOM and DAD stand face to face arguing angrily, DAD pointing his finger, MOM shouting back; BOY peeks scared from behind a doorframe.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Morning at a small kitchen table with mint tea glasses and bread: DAD slams his hand on the table angrily, MOM looks away upset with arms crossed.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: BOY walks home from school with his backpack in a narrow Moroccan derb street with blue and white walls in late afternoon light; curious neighbours lean out of windows and doorways staring at him and whispering.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a simple bedroom MOM quickly stuffs clothes into a big travel bag on the bed, her face sad and determined; BOY stands in the doorway with his backpack, shocked, mouth open.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MOM sits alone on the edge of a low sofa in a dim room, eyes tired and teary, hands in her lap, holding back her sadness patiently.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: MOM walks out through the open wooden front door of the house carrying her big travel bag; BOY runs after her from inside the hallway with his arms reaching out, crying.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the front door BOY clings tightly to MOM's back with both arms, crying, trying to stop her from leaving; MOM pulls forward away from him holding her bag.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: DAD and BOY stand in the open doorway of the house watching a distant figure in a mustard-yellow djellaba walk away down the narrow derb street; BOY looks heartbroken, DAD looks cold.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Evening in the living room: DAD sits on the sofa secretly smiling at his mobile phone, hiding the screen; BOY watches him suspiciously from the corridor.
